issues.description: The solution declares Genre.name with 'private' visibility but Client.swift accesses genre.name. 'private' in Swift restricts access to the enclosing declaration (not other files), so Client in a different file cannot read this property. This creates a compile-time error and contradicts the problem's model where Genre has a name that should be readable for printing.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the Genre.name property accessible to clients that print the inventory. Replace 'private let name: String' with 'let name: String' (or 'fileprivate' if you intend file-level protection) so Client.swift can read genre.name and the code compiles while preserving immutability.
